items.description: Designated LB Swayze Bozeman to return from injured reserve.
Signed TE Carsen Ryan to the practice squad.
Signed G Jake Kubas and OLB Bralen Trice to the practice squad.
Signed CB Riley Moss to a four-year contract extension.
Released S Justin Reid.
Signed WR Malik Heath to the practice squad.
Signed OT Albert Reese to the practice squad. Released OT Da'Metrius Weatherspoon from the practice squad.
Activated CB Jaylin Smith from injured reserve.
Reinstated WR Tyrell Shavers from the physically unable to perform list.
Designated S Jalen Thompson to return from injured reserve.
Reinstated DB Kerby Joseph from the physically unable to perform list. Placed DE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve. Signed DB Nick Whiteside to the practice squad.
Designated G Fernando Carmona to return from injured reserve.

Reinstated DT Omarr Norman-Lott from the physically unable to perform list. Placed TE Jared Wiley on injured reserve. Signed T Fred Johnson to the practice squad. Released LB Cole Christiansen from the practice squad.
Signed WR Brennan Presley to the practice squad.
Signed DE Max Llewellyn from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed P Jack Browning to the practice squad.
Signed WR Jeshaun Jones from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed WR D'Wayne Eskridge to the practice squad. Placed LB Bo Richter on injured reserve.
Signed T Colby Sorsdal to the practice squad.
Signed WR Charlie Jones and DB Nikko Reed to the practice squad. Released C Geno VanDeMark from the practice squad.
Designated DT David Onyemata to return from injured reserve.
Claimed T Ajani Cornelius off waivers from Dallas.
Signed WR Bub Means and DB Jerrick Reed to the practice squad. Released WR James Proche from the practice squad.

Reinstated WR Max Hurleman from the practice squad injured list. Designated G Gennings Dunker and WRs Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson to return from injured reserve. Placed G Mason McCormick on injured reserve. Released WR Isaiah Hodgins from the practice squad.
Signed DT Deven Eastern to the practice squad. Released QB Adrian Martinez from the practice squad.
Signed LB Nick Hampton to the practice squad. Placed LB Claudin Cherelus on the practice squad injured list.
Reinstated RB Adam Randall from injured reserve. Signed G Michael Jordan to the practice squad.
